observations_not_blocking.title: lock-metadata support chip on the live pages uses the whole-session race rain flag
observations_not_blocking.detail: app_v2/services/support_service.support_for reads lock events[ev].rain.R (a post-session flag) into vm.support.overall_support_status, rendered as 'lock chips say ...' on live_predictor.py:175 and decision_board.py:90; Workstream 8's 7.1 support_status (the primary chip) uses the per-lap rain of laps <= k. All demo replays (Monza, Austria, Barcelona) are dry (R False) so nothing renders differently today; a wet-race replay (Miami, Zandvoort) would show the race verdict before the rain fell
observations_not_blocking.suggested_fix: on the live path derive the rain context from cursor.visible()['rain'] (laps <= k) or drop the lock chip on live routes

observations_not_blocking.detail: pid 86120 started 21:49:46; live/viewmodel.py was rewritten 22:01:33 and decision/optimizer.py 22:01:51 (red-team rule live_position_claim). Streamlit does not reload already-imported modules, so that process serves the pre-reword versions. Verified to make NO rendered difference: both live pages take app_v2/services/live_bridge.rejoin_text (unchanged since 21:16) whenever the 7.2 record has rejoin_context.position_now, and all three demo records (Monza, Austria, Barcelona NOR) have it populated, so the reworded live/viewmodel string is unreachable from the UI. No number differs: the consistency probe re-rendered all 15 routes in-process against the current tree with 0 mismatches.
observations_not_blocking.suggested_fix: restart the 8502 dashboard once more before the demo so the running process matches the tree: ../.venv/bin/streamlit run app_v2/streamlit_app.py --server.port 8502 --server.headless true --browser.gatherUsageStats false

observations_not_blocking.title: claim_audit now distinguishes a bare claim from the same number stated with its required qualification (reclassification logged, not silent)
observations_not_blocking.detail: At 21:42 liquid_23_pct_10_of_31 (verdict unverifiable) counted 3 occurrences in talk_track.md, THE_CASE.md and pptx slide 8. Re-reading those lines shows the lead had already corrected them to exactly what out/liquid.json supports: "23% lap-weighted with the three degenerate Hungary cells excluded, 31% with them" and "9 of 31 cells" (the old wrong count was 10 of 31). The regex 23%|10 of 31 cannot see the caveat, so the occurrence was a false positive. claim_audit.locate() now records per occurrence whether every qualified_by pattern is present in that source, and the gate blocks only UNQUALIFIED occurrences on the presentation surfaces - while newly blocking `unverifiable` verdicts there, which the C3 gate ignored entirely. Net effect is stricter, not looser. The claim verdict itself is unchanged (the BARE claim remains unverifiable).
observations_not_blocking.note: summary.qualified_in_presentation in claim_evidence_map.json lists every reclassification with its file:line, so a human can audit the judgement.

observations_not_blocking.title: live_position_claim still flags app_v2/services/live_bridge.py:99 - assessed as a false positive, rule deliberately left strict
observations_not_blocking.detail: The rule allows the match when "frozen_field" appears on the same line. The lead satisfied that at live/viewmodel.py:175 and decision/optimizer.py:117,134 with an end-of-line comment, but live_bridge.py:99 (parts = [f"P{rj['position_now']} now"]) carries its qualification in the function docstring (lines 93-94, "No projected P-number is shown on the live path") and in the appended label at line 106 (" . observed gap structure, not a position forecast"). Substantively the rendered value is the OBSERVED current position, which the rule's own note permits; the projected P-number is never rendered outside frozen-field mode. Widening allowed_context to the enclosing function would let a genuine future violation hide behind an unrelated frozen_field mention, so the rule was NOT relaxed and the flag stands as a known false positive.
observations_not_blocking.suggested_fix: either add the same end-of-line "frozen_field mode" marker the other three lines carry, or accept the flag and record it here (current state).
